claims.text: 根据BEA公告，2025年7月总体PCE价格指数环比（较上月）上升0.2%；同比（较上年同月）上升2.6%。两种口径不同：环比衡量月度变化，同比衡量年度变化。

citations.quotation: From the preceding month, the PCE price index for July increased 0.2 percent.
From the same month one year ago, the PCE price index for July increased 2.6 percent.

counterarguments.text: 无相反证据；但摘要提及剔除食品和能源的核心PCE（环比0.3%、同比2.9%）易与总体口径混淆，需区分。

citations.quotation: Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 0.3 percent.
Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 2.9 percent from one year ago.

limitations: 来源为节选（partial coverage），非公告全文
发布日期为声明值（2025-08-29），未经核实
本回答仅涉及总体PCE，核心PCE数据一并引用仅作区分说明

facts.label: 总体PCE价格指数环比变化

citation.quotation: the PCE price index for July increased 0.2 percent

facts.label: 总体PCE价格指数同比变化

citation.quotation: the PCE price index for July increased 2.6 percent
